exposure: Use of midwife for prenatal care
Use of physician for prenatal care
Use of midwife as birth attendant
Use of physician as birth attendant
outcome: Sociodemographic characteristics (e.g., race, marital status, age)
Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) support
cohort: The study participants were women who used a midwife or a physician for prenatal care and/or birth, drawn from the nationally representative Listening to Mothers III survey.
finding: Women who use midwives for prenatal care or birth are largely similar to women who use physicians, which does not support the common perception that midwife patients are a self-selected group of wealthier, more educated women.
mod_finding: Women who used a midwife as a birth attendant were similar to women who used a physician as a birth attendant in most characteristics, with the exception of age over 35 years and WIC support.
